Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this lopsided game. The last ODI is on Thursday, 9th June 2022, at 12.45 pm IST (7.15 am GMT). You can join us in advance for the build-up. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Ibrahim Zadran (120*) is the Player of the Match! The opener says that he wanted to play his natural game. Adds that the partnership with Rahmat was wonderful and he really enjoys batting with him. Mentions that they got 20 points in the Super League and they want to play positive cricket to win the next game as well.

Hashmatullah Shahidi, the captain of Afghanistan, says that he is very happy with the win and the way his team is performing at the moment. Adds that they wanted to get all 30 points from this tour and they will be targeting 10 more in the next game. When asked about making changes to his winning XI for the next game, Shahidi replies that he will think about it in the coming days.

Craig Ervine, the captain of Zimbabwe, says that they knew the pitch flattens out in the afternoon and that's why it was important to get partnerships. Feels that they had a reasonable start but didn't kick on afterwards. Shares that this pitch was much better than the first game and 260-270 would have been competitive. Emphasizes on the getting the partnerships and this is the area they need to work on.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the match, Fazalhaq Farooqi was exceptional with the new ball and got plenty of movement. Zimbabwe stuttered at the start but then recovered through a few partnerships. Innocent Kaia, Sikandar Raza and Ryan Burl played handy knocks, but the innings lacked the overall momentum to post a challenging total on the board.

Zimbabwe were listless with the ball, and they weren't great with their ground fielding either. Yet another disappointing outing for them. On a surface, that had something for the pacers, especially with the new ball, the likes of Blessing Muzarabani and Tendai Chatara didn't find enough to trouble the batters, and the rest of the bowlers also struggled for rhythm and penetration. Plenty of work to do for the hosts to improve their game in both the facets of the game.

Chasing a below-par target, the Afghans did lose Rahmanullah Gurbaz for yet another low score but Ibrahim Zadran and Rahmat Shah batted positively and helped Afghanistan navigate through Powerplay 1 without any more damage. The number of boundaries that the Afghan batters scored early in the innings was the main highlight, and that, in a way, never allowed Zimbabwe to exert any pressure. Thereafter, the duo raised a record stand for the second wicket and put the chase to bed. Zadran notched up his maiden ODI hundred in the process, but Rahmat missed out on yet another ton on this tour, this time by 12 runs.

Easy victory for Afghanistan. A bit boring in terms of competition but certainly commanding from Afghanistan's point of view. Another 10 points for them, and they have strengthened their spot at number 3 on the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup Super League 2020-2022/23 table.

Full length, on off. Ibrahim Zadran hits it down to mid on. The fielder fumbles which allows the batters to cross for a single. It is Ibrahim Zadran with the winning run. What an incredible knock by him! AFGHANISTAN WIN BY 8 WICKETS.
Full length, on off. Zadran blocks it to backward point.
A length ball, on off. Shahidi dabs it to point for a single.
FOUR! Cracking shot! It is a short ball, on the bodyline. Zadran shuffles and pulls it into the gap between fine leg and square leg.
Fuller, outside off. Zadran pushes it gently towards covers.
Length, outside off, left alone by Zadran.
FOUR! Top shot! Back of a length, on off. Zadran stays back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Zadran seems to be in a hurry here.
Fuller, on the pads. Zadran flicks it to mid-wicket. The fielder there makes a brilliant stop to save a single here.
An appeal for lbw but turned down! It is full and angled into the pads. Zadran ends up playing all around it. The ball comes off the pads to the leg side. Tiripano appeals but the umpire is unmoved.
Outside off, left alone. Afghanistan need more 10 runs to win.
Short ball again, outside off. Zadran punches it to covers from the back foot, this time for a single.
Short ball, outside off. Zadran punches it to covers from the back foot.
Length ball, outside off. Zadran smothers it back to the bowler.
WIDE! It is short and angled down leg. Zadran tries to flick it away but misses. Wide called.
Length ball, on off. Zadran steers it to backward point for a brace. This is really good running.
Good length, outside off. Zadran stays back and punches it to the right of sweeper cover. The batters take two.
Outside off, left alone.
Back of a length yet again, this time angled across the left-hander. Shahidi lets it be.
WIDE! Shorter, down the leg side. Shahidi fails to flick it away. Wided.
On a length, outside off, left alone.
Hashmatullah Shahidi is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Donald Tiripano finds the breakthrough finally for Zimbabwe. A dagger through the heart for Rahmat Shah. He is unable to get to a major milestone for the second time in this series. He will be livid with himself. It is a short ball, wide outside off. Shah goes hunting away from his body with a cut shot. He edges it behind where the keeper, Regis Chakabva makes no mistake. The umpire though has a look at the front foot. The replays show Donald Tiripano had some part of the foot behind the line. Rahmat Shah continues his walk to the dressing room.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Donald Tiripano

Good length, on top of off. Zadran waits for it and dabs it down to third man for a single.
Flatter and wide outside off. Zadran punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Around off, Zadran pushes it to cover.
Shah uses his feet this time, gets to the pitch of the delivery and hits it down to long on for a single.
Around middle and leg. Shah works it to the leg side.
On off, blocked out.
FOUR! Shah goes downtown! Incredible shot. Full length, outside off. Shah stands tall and drills it past the man at mid off for a boundary.
End of Powerplay 2! Now, 5 fielders can be placed outside the circle until the end of this match.
Uses the angle of the bowler and pushes it towards mid on.
Back of a length, outside off, Zadran tries to punch but misses.
Fulller and outside off, Shah drives it to point where the fielder makes a partial stop. A single.
Wide! Bouncer goes well over the head of the batter.
Stays back and punches it to covers.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Shah whacks it from the back foot to deep cover for a boundary.
Around off, blocked.
The batter has just watchfully blocked this out.
Too full and on off, stroked down to long on for a run.
Gets forward and pushes it through covers for one.
Helps it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Turning down the leg side, Ibrahim fails to pull and is hit on the pads. The appeal for an lbw is not upheld.
Eases a full ball down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Maiden hundred for Ibrahim Zadran! He plays a crunching cover drive for a boundary. Massive moment for him!
Presses forward and blocks it.
Too full and around off, stroked straight down the ground for a single. Blessing fumbled and allowed the second run.
Around off, defended back.
Outside off, eased away to short third man for a couple.
Gets on the front foot and blocks it safely to the off side.
Fires it flat and around middle, it's defended from the back foot.
Very full and around off, it's fired in, the batter clips it to short mid-wicket.
A long hop on off, Ibrahim forces it to long on for a run.
A low full toss, around leg, Zadran hits it across the line but finds short mid-wicket.
Short again, around off, this time Shah punches it down to long on for a run.
Turning in from around off, Shah stays back and punches it to short mid-wicket.
Around middle and leg. Shah eases it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played. A short ball, on off. Shah stays back and pulls it through mid-wicket for four.
On off, defended out.
On off, blocked back to the bowler.
Another single as this is pushed down the ground.
Fuller, on middle. Shah eases it to long on for one.
On off blocked out.
Full, on leg, Shah works it behind square on the on side for a single.
Floated and at the stumps, Zadran flicks it to the leg side for a run.
Full and on the pads, Shah clips it to the leg side for a single.
On middle and leg. Zadran tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! Quicker and full, down the leg side. Wided.
Angled into the pads, tucked to square leg.
Tossed up, on off. Zadran works it to the off side for one.
A single now as this is pushed down the ground.
A single to long on.
Is that a run out? The replays show Rahmat Shah had his bat grounded.

A low full toss, on off, Zadran slaps it to covers but the fielder makes a great stop. He scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but the ball rolls away which allows the batters to take a single. The third umpire is referred but Rahmat is safe.
Worked to long off for a run.
Full and on off. Zadran drives it down the ground for a single.
Flatter and on middle, Rahmat Shah defends it towards mid-wicket again.
On middle, Rahmat Shah uses his feet and defends it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on leg, Rahmat Shah flicks it to square leg.
Flatter and on middle, Ibrahim Zadran pushes it past the bowler for one.
On middle, blocked.
On leg, Rahmat Shah flicks it to mid-wicket for one. 150 partnership up between Rahmat Shah and Ibrahim Zadran.
FOUR! The second one of the over. Zadran moves to 87. Back of a length, near the ribs. Zadran gets inside the line and flicks it to fine leg for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off. Zadran pushes it to cover.

With the physio tending to Tanaka Chivanga, the umpires have decided to take the second official Drinks break. The one-way traffic continues in this chase. Zimbabwe have failed to deliver with the ball and are on the cusp of losing yet another match. Only 67 needed more for Afghanistan.

FOUR! Cracking shot! Full length, outside off. Ibrahim Zadran goes after it and crunches it through covers for a boundary. Tanaka Chivanga is on the ground, it looks like he hurt himself after landing in the delivery stride.
A length ball, on off. Zadran blocks it out watchfully.
A sharp bouncer, on off. Zadran ducks under it.
On leg, this is flicked towards id-wicket for one. 150 partnership up for Ibrahim Zadran and Rahmat Shah.
Flatter and on off, Ibrahim Zadran drives it to long off for one.
Flatter and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran defends it out solidly.
On middle, blocked towards mid on.
Fuller and on off, Rahmat Shah eases it towards mid on. Wesley Madhevere was on his way to stop it but had a collision with the batter at the non-striker's end. Single taken.
On middle, Ibrahim Zadran flicks it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Wesley Madhevere starts with a full toss, Rahmat Shah flicks it but straight towards the fielder at mid-wicket. Single taken.
Change. Wesley Madhevere comes into the attack.
Chivanga bowls short again, outside off, Shah forces it to deep cover for a run.
Shortish and on off, Rahmat is on his toes as he defends it to the off side.
The line is too straight and it's eased away in the gap at deep mid-wicket for two.

FOUR! Misfield in the deep! Zimbabwe have given up, it seems. Back of a length, around middle and leg, Shah deflects it down to fine leg where the fielder fumbles and concedes a boundary. This now is the best partnership for Afghanistan, for the second wicket, against Zimbabwe in ODIs.
Angles it in, around off, blocked to covers.
Around off, on a length, Rahmat drives it on the up but it doesn't carry to the mid off fielder.
Change. Tanaka Chivanga comes back into the attack now.
Strides forward and defends it to covers. 82 needed more.
FOUR! Picks up the gap on this occasion! Shumba delivers it short and around off, Zadran camps back and packs a punch past the cover fielder for a cracking boundary.
Goes on the back foot and punches it well but finds the cover fielder.
Lunges to a full ball and pushes it with an angled bat to short third man.
Short and wide, cut from the back foot to deep point for a single.
Fires it in, flat and full around off, Rahmat defends it to the off side.
All too easy for Afghanistan at the moment. Shah tucks this one in acres of space at deep mid-wicket and collects three runs.
Pitches it up and around off, Rahmat pushes it firmly to short extra cover.
Wide! Bouncer, down the leg side, it's left alone.

Very full and around off, Shah crunches his drive to covers. The fielder there dives and parries it to mid off. The batters cross. There is a direct hit at the striker's end and the ball deflects away towards third man. They cross for one more. FIFTY FOR SHAH! He continues with his purple patch.
Width there outside off, Shah plays at it from the back foot but finds the point fielder.
Full and around off, Shah checks his shot and pushes it calmly to cover-point.
JUST SHORT! Fuller in length and outside off, Shah goes for the drive through the line but gets a thick outside edge. It lands just ahead of Craig Ervine at gully.
Plays it all along the ground, down to long on and keeps strike with a single. 93 needed more.

FOUR! BANG! Milton Shumba tosses it up and lands it full around off, Rahmat Shah shimmies down the track and bludgeons it past the bowler. Donald Tiripano tries his best, coming across to his right from long off, but his effort goes in vain.
Eases a full ball to long off and crosses.
Perhaps the arm ball, full and around off, skidding in, Shah pushes it down to long on, off the inner half, and collects a single.
Drags his length short and delivers it outside off, Zadran rocks back and slaps it to deep cover for one.
Extra loop on this delivery but the length is very full and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran drives it square of the wicket on the off side and picks up a couple of runs.
Change. Milton Shumba comes into the attack now.

FOUR! Quality shot! Fuller in length, around off, Rahmat shows the maker's name as he caresses it straight down the ground for a boundary. Sublime. The field was up and the quick outfield took the ball to the fence in no time.
This one holds up a bit on the surface. A touch short and outside off, Shah mistimes his punch towards covers.
Dishes out a length delivery in the channel outside off, going straight on, Rahmat has nothing to do with it.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it towards mid on.

Almost drags it on! Blessing bowls it on a length and around off, some extra bounce, Zadran tries to punch off the back foot but it catches the inside edge, beats the stumps and scoots down to fine leg. The batsmen take a single.
Begins his new spell with a shortish delivery outside off, Zadran plays late and eases it wide of the gully fielder in place.
Change. Blessing Muzarabani (6-0-31-1) is back into the attack.
Angles it in, on a length, Zadran bunts it down to mid on and scampers across to the other end.
Digs it in short again, outside off, Rahmat uses the pace and runs it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length, outside off, it's guided down to third man for one.
Length delivery, outside off, Shah strokes it through covers for a single.

Bangs it in short, around off, Zadran pulls it through square leg for a single. Confusion over the second run, the fielder fumbles as well but Zadran is still sent back by Rahmat. The 100-run stand comes up.
Short delivery, outside off, Zadran tries to cut but mistimes it to covers.
Walks down to the pitch of the delivery and pushes it back towards the bowler. Tidy over by Raza but Zimbabwe need wickets.
Tossed up, full and around off, Rahmat plays a cute lap sweep down to fine leg to break the string of dots. Takes a couple.
Delivers it full and wide outside off, Shah drills his drive but picks out mid off.  Four dots in the over.
Floated and full, around off, Shah plays the reverse-batted sweep but finds short third man.
Fuller and around leg, flicked this time to square leg but once again not in the gap.
Loopy and full around off, Shah flicks but finds short mid-wicket.
On a good length around off, blocked watchfully.
The batter has just blocked that from his crease.
Wide! Short once more, wide outside off, the batters leave.
Drifting down the leg side, it's clipped to deep square leg for a couple.
Short again, around off, played down from the back foot to covers.
Shortish and around off, Zadran defends it again on the leg side.
A length ball, on middle and leg, Shah tries flicking but misses. It clips his pads and deflects to mid-wicket.
A touch short and on off, Ibrahim rocks back and punches it down to long on for one. 6 runs from the over, Afghanistan are going along nice and easy. 118 needed off 168 balls.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a couple of runs.
Flighted and on off, forced down to long on for another run.
Knocks a full ball down to long on for a single.
Rahmat Shah becomes the leading run-scorer for Afghanistan in ODIs, overtaking Mohammad Nabi! Flighted and full, outside off, Shah drives it through covers for a run.
FOUR! Zadran is not shying away from playing his shots against the short deliveries. A half-tracker on middle, Ibrahim Zadran top-edges his attempted pull shot down to fine leg for a boundary.

EDGED AND DROPPED! A good effort nonetheless from Regis Chakabva. Short again from Donald, outside off, Ibrahim Zadran also tries to run it down to third man but there is some extra bounce and it takes the outside edge. The keeper dives full stretch to his right, but it brushes his gloves and deflects behind. They get two runs.
Short in length and outside off, Rahmat stands back and guides it down to third man for a run.
Sliding down the leg side, on a length, Zadran clips it through square leg for a run.
Back of a length, again it's blocked from the back foot.
Short and around off, defended from the crease to the off side.

The replay of 18.3 comes and it shows that there was a spike. No one heard any edge and hence there was no appeal. Lucky escape for Rahmat Shah. A bowling change now for Zimbabwe, as Donald Tiripano comes into the attack.
Flatter, angled into the body. Zadran uses the depth of his crease and pushes it to long on for a single.
Another single as this is worked down the ground to long on.
Flatter, on middle. Zadran goes back and works it to long on for a run.
Fuller, on off, Zadran tucks it to the leg side.
Tossed up, around middle and leg. Shah clips it through mid-wicket for one more.
Fuller and on off. Zadran pushes it to cover for a single. Maiden ODI fifty for Ibrahim Zadran and he raises his bat towards his dugout.
Change! Sikandar Raza to have a go now.
Change.
Angling in, from a length around off, Shah again pushes it defensively, this time towards mid off.
Gets behind the line of the ball and blocks it solidly.
Fuller and outside off, Shah drives this time, from the meat of the bat but finds the cover fielder.
Beaten! On a length and outside off, holding its line, Shah tries to drive but misses.
FOUR! This is pleasing to the eyes! A full-length ball, on off. Shah leans in and drives it past the bowler for a boundary straight down the ground. Incredible shot.
Back of a length, on off. Shah dabs it down to point.
Short ball, on off. Shah pulls it to the leg side for a single.
Fuller, too straight, on the pads. Zadran tucks it to square leg for a single.
Angles it into the pads, Shah sticks back and flicks it through mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
Touch fuller, on off. Shah hangs back and blocks it out watchfully.
Length ball, around off. Shah looks to defend it out, but outside-edges it to gully.
On a length, on off. Shah defends it to point.
Short ball, on off. Shah pulls it past mid-wicket for a single.
A full-length ball, on off. Shah gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Outside off, left alone.
A short ball, outside off. Zadran cuts it to point for a single.
Fuller, wide outside off. Zadran slashes but misses.
A length ball, on the pads, Shah tucks it square on the on side for a single.

Drinks break. Afghanistan are in the driving seat at the moment. Ibrahim Zadran seems to be settled in and would hope to make his innings count. Zimbabwe, on the flip side, have not been great with the ball. They have brilliant individual players but have been unable to operate as a team. They need wickets to get back in this game but no idea from where it will come. Looks like one-way traffic again.
Play and a miss! A length ball, outside off. Zadran tries to chase it but is unable to get any bat on ball. Just a single off the over then.
Good length, on middle and leg. Zadran looks to flick it away but it goes back to the bowler off the outer half.
Back of a length, on off. Zadran tries to work it to the leg side but the ball dies in front of him.
Touch shorter, on off. Shah gets inside the line and tucks it to square leg for a single.
Good length, on off. Shah defends it to the leg side.
A beauty of a delivery! A length ball and in the channel. Shah tries to defend it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On middle, Ibrahim Zadran defends it to mid on.
Flatter and outside off, this is guided towards the off side for one.
On off, guided towards covers for one.
FOUR! Fine footwork from Ibrahim Zadran. He dances down to the pitch of the delivery and lofts it cleanly over mid on for a boundary.
Fuller and on off, Rahmat Shah drives it to covers for one.
Flatter and wide outside off, Rahmat Shah looks to drive it but misses.
Outside off, Ibrahim Zadran defends it towards the off side.
Length ball shaping away from the batter, defended towards the bowler.
Similar to the last delivery, Ibrahim Zadran eases it towards the off side.
On a good length and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran guides it to point.
Fuller and outside leg, Ibrahim Zadran looks to flick it but misses. Wide called.
A single now as this is guided down to third man.
A short ball, on off. Zadran pulls it to square leg for one.
On the pads, Zadran tucks it to mid-wicket. The batters call for two but Milton Shumba is quick to get to the ball. They only get a single. A tidy first over by Burl, only three runs off it.
Fuller and around off. Zadran lunges forward and defends it out to safety.
Short ball, outside off. Zadran taps it to point where the fielder makes a fine stop.

SAFE! A better throw from the deep would have got Ibrahim Zadran. Short in length and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran rocks back and forces it through cover-point. He wants the second run and scampers back. Both the batters are ball-watching and there is a minor collision. Meanwhile, the throw comes to the keeper but Regis Chakabva has to collect it way ahead of the stumps. He then deflects it onto the stumps and appeals. The replays find Ibrahim safe.
Is that a run out? The square leg umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The replays suggest that Ibrahim Zadran had his blade grounded as the bails were coming off. The big screen shows NOT OUT.
Flatter and on off, Ibrahim Zadran defends it towards mid off.
On middle, defended out.
Change. Ryan Burl comes into the attack now.
Outside off, Ibrahim Zadran again guides it towards the third man region. Single taken.
Shorter again and on leg, Rahmat Shah guides it towards point for a single.
Length ball and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran eases it down to third man for a run.

IN THE AIR... Lands safely! Tanaka Chivanga surprises the batter with a bumper. It's well-directed and Ibrahim Zadran plays a reactive pull shot. The bounce gets big on his blade and it flies off the top edge to fine leg. Blessing Muzarabani is standing too square, runs across to his right but it drops safely. The batters collect a couple.
Darts it on leg, Ibrahim Zadran looks to give it a fine tickle but the ball hits his pads. The ball races towards short fine leg. A couple of leg byes taken.
Length ball and on the stumps, Ibrahim Zadran eases it back towards Tanaka Chivanga.
Back of a length again and outside off, Shah leaves it through and towards the keeper.
Back of a length this time and on middle, Rahmat Shah defends it to the off side. A bit aerially but safely.
On middle, Ibrahim Zadran eases it past the bowler and towards mid on. Single taken.
FOUR! Fuller in length and on middle, Ibrahim Zadran flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full and on middle, defended towards mid on.
Blessing Muzarabani bowls it outside off and on length, Ibrahim Zadran leaves it alone.
End of Powerplay 1! That means now 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the 40th over!

FOUR! Chivanga doesn't finish the over well. Goes short and around off, Rahmat is quick to pick the change in length. He rocks back to ride the bounce and pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary. At the end of Powerplay 1, Afghanistan are 56/1.
Gets behind the line and blocks it towards mid on.
Outside off, left alone.

Tanaka Chivanga tries to repeat the last delivery from the middle stump line. This time though there isn't any movement and it goes down with the angle. Rahmat tickles it behind square leg. Blessing Muzarabani makes a fine stop near the fence, saving a couple for his team.
Brilliant delivery! Beautiful seam presentation from Tanaka Chivanga. He angles it around off, on a fuller length, Shah tries to drive but gets beaten by the away movement.
Back of a length, around off, Shah is on his back foot in defense.
Play Halted! The physio is out to have a look at Ibrahim Zadran.

Well bowled! Extra bounce there. It lands it on a good length around off and nips back in. Zadran tries to defend but gets struck on the gloves. The ball goes behind to the keeper on one bounce. The replays, later on, show that it was not gloves. It came off the elbow. That's a painful blow.

FOUR! Another aerial shot but this time it's quite far away from Wesley Madhevere. Short and around off, Zadran rocks back and pulls it powerfully to the deep mid-wicket fence. 50 up for Afghanistan, a steady start from them.
FOUR! Up and just over mid-wicket! A slice of luck for Ibrahim Zadran. Fuller in length, around leg, Ibrahim Zadran flicks it aerially and it flies over Wesley Madhevere for a boundary.
Width there outside off, on a good length, Shah goes back and steers it past backward point. The third man fielder cuts it off and they take a single.
Around off, on a length, the batter has just blocked that from his crease.

Hurls across a shortish delivery outside off, Rahmat allows it through. It keeps on dying in front of Regis Chakabva who fails to collect it and deflects the ball behind to fine leg. The batters steal a couple of byes.
Slightly short and on off, pushed away from the back foot to short cover.
Identical to the last delivery, around off and angling in, once again Zadran is solid in his defense.
Nice length, around off, defended back from the crease.
Back of a length, around off, Zadran turns it with the angle of the bowler but finds the short mid-wicket fielder.
Digs it in short, outside off, Shah goes on his toes and guides it to third man for a single.
Begins with a good-length delivery, around off, Rahmat is on the back foot with a straight bat as he defends.
Delivers it on a good length, close to off and angling in, Zadran is on the back foot and blocks it down safely.
On a length and outside off, Zadran is on the front foot and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Zadran shows restrain. Short in length and wide outside off, Ibrahim offers no shot.
Full and outside off, Shah plays late. He opens the face of his bat and runs it down to third man for a run.
Beauty! Blessing hits the right length and line. It's around off and straightens off the seam, Rahmat is squared up in defense as the ball whistles past the outside edge.
Lands it on a length, around off, Rahmat is on the front foot as he defends it to covers.
Flashes and misses! Short delivery, wide outside off, Zadran gets carried away. He attempts to slam it over point but misses.

FOUR! Another easy boundary for Ibrahim. Chatara is very inconsistent with his line and length. Serves it full and on the pads, Ibrahim Zadran has no qualms in putting it away to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Full this time, angling in from around off, Zadran defends it with a straight bat.
FOUR! Put away in style! Too short and too wide outside off, Ibrahim Zadran rocks on the back foot and spanks it through cover-point.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it to mid on.
Back of a length, around off and shaping in, Zadran stays back to punch but is cramped for room. It takes the bottom half and goes on the leg side.
Movement off the pitch. On a length around off, Zadran presents a straight bat and it goes off the inner edge to backward square leg. One more run off the over, 6 from it!
Uses the angle of the bowler and works a full ball wide of mid on for a run.

FOUR! Classy Rahmat! Full and outside off, Shah presses forward and drives it elegantly through the gap at cover-point for a boundary. He is the batter in good touch for the Afghans and this shot shows how good his form is!
Fuller and on off, Rahmat defends it ahead of his front pad.
Bowls it in the corridor outside off, Shah lets it be.
Delivers it on a length and around off, Rahmat is on the back foot as he defends it down with soft hands.
Slants it on a length and close to off, Ibrahim gets behind the line and blocks.
Around off, the batter has just blocked that from his crease.
FOUR! Chatara overcorrects his line and goes middle and leg. The length is full and Zadran deflects it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Fullish and wide outside off, just inside the tram line, Ibrahim Zadran lets it through to the keeper.
Width there outside off, on a good length, Rahmat pushes inside the line and edges it down to third man for a run.
In the region outside off, Rahmat offers no shot.
Full length, on off. Zadran stays back and defends it out covers. A wicket-taking over by Blessing Muzarabani comes to an end.
Goes fuller this time, on off. Zadran gets an inside edge onto his pads.
A length ball, on off. Shah inside-edges it to square leg for a single.
Rahmat Shah comes in at number 3.

OUT! LBW! Blessing Muzarabani appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Rahmanullah Gurbaz has a chat with his partner at the other end and opts to go for the review. It is a length ball, that pitches outside off and nips in off the deck. Rahmanullah Gurbaz is caught inside his crease. He tries to flick it away but fails to get any bat on it. He gets pinged on his pads. Blessing appeals and the umpire wastes no time in raising his finger. The UltraEdge confirms no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows three reds. Early blow to Afghanistan.
Length ball, on off, blocked out to the off side.
Back of a length, on middle and leg. Gurbaz stays back, closes the face of the blade and tucks it to the leg side. He ventures out looking for a single but is sent back wisely.
FOUR! Fine shot! Too full in length, around middle and leg, Ibrahim once again leans across a bit in his stance and whips it wide of mid on for a boundary. It's been a great start for Afghanistan.
Around off, on a length, Zadran defends it from the back foot.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Zadran also opens his account with a boundary. Fuller in length, around middle, Ibrahim Zadran leans across and flicks it with excellent timing for a boundary at deep mid-wicket.
Fires it full and around off, Zadran defends it from the full face of his bat.
Chatara pulls his length back and serves it around off, Zadran punches it from the back foot and it goes on one bounce to the point fielder.
Starts with a full-length delivery, around off, Ibrahim Zadran is on the front foot as he defends it to cover.
Tendai Chatara to bowl from the other end, with the second new ball. Two slips in place.
Fraction short and close to off, angling in, Gurbaz defends it from the back foot to point.
FOUR! Slapped away! Blessing Muzarabani strays in his line and length. Short and wide outside off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz reaches out and slaps it through cover-point for a boundary.
On a length and outside off, Gurbaz stays on the back foot and taps it down towards covers.
Blessing goes fuller this time, around off, Gurbaz gets forward slightly and defends it.
Back of a length, again around off, Gurbaz walks across a bit and defends it to the off side.
Better this time. On a length around off, angling in, Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets behind the line and blocks it safely.
FIVE WIDES! Not the start Zimbabwe were looking for! The bouncer goes wrong, it's way down the leg side, away from the batter and the keeper. The ball scoots away to the fine leg fence.
